name: Jambo
summary: Two-player trading card game where rival African merchants buy and sell goods to be first to amass 60 gold.
rules_text: Two players start with a large 6-space stand, 20 gold, and 5 cards from a shuffled deck of ware, utility, people, animal and small-stand cards. On your turn you have 5 action markers. Phase 1: you may draw up to 5 times; each draw costs 1 action, you look at the top card and must either keep it (ending phase 1) or discard it to draw again. You may keep only the last drawn card. Phase 2: playing 1 card costs 1 action. Ware cards are used to buy all pictured wares from supply at cost on left, if you have space and gold, or sell them for value on right. Sixth slot on large stand costs 2 gold. Small stands cost 6 then 3 gold and add 3 spaces, limit 5 in game. Utility cards stay face-up, max 3, usable once per turn for 1 action. People and animal cards give one-time effects, then discard; animals can be cancelled by opponent's guard at no cost. Unused actions >=2 give 1 gold bonus. Game ends when a player has 60+ gold at end of turn; opponent gets one final 5-action turn and wins if tied or ahead, otherwise triggering player wins.
rating_reason: 2p card trading race to 60 gold strategic
